string-array.name: quotes_anxious
string-array.item: Breathe. You are stronger than you think.
You have survived every hard moment so far. This one is no different.
Not every thought you have is true. Let this one pass by like a cloud.
You don\'t have to solve everything right now. Just this breath.
Your body is trying to protect you. You can tell it you\'re safe.
Slow down. There is time.
Feel your feet on the ground. You are here, and here is okay.
Worry is a story about the future. Right now, you are okay.
One small step is enough for today.
Anxiety is loud, but it is not in charge of you.
It\'s okay to pause. Rest is not giving up.

string-array.name: quotes_upset
string-array.item: This moment will pass, and you will rise again.
It\'s okay to feel this. Feelings are visitors, not permanent residents.
You\'re allowed to be upset. You\'re also allowed to let it go when you\'re ready.
Take a breath before you take the next step.
Storms don\'t last forever, even the loud ones.
Be gentle with yourself. You\'re carrying a lot right now.
You can\'t control everything, but you can choose how you care for yourself.
Let it out, then let it settle.
Anger and hurt are signals, not instructions.
Tomorrow is a fresh page.
You don\'t have to respond to everything right away.

string-array.name: quotes_depressed
string-array.item: You matter. Your story is not over.
Even on the days you don\'t feel it, you are worthy of care.
Getting through today counts. That is enough.
Small things are still things. Drinking water counts. Getting up counts.
The fog lifts, even when it doesn\'t feel like it will.
You are not a burden. You are a person going through something hard.
Reaching out is a sign of strength, not weakness.
You don\'t have to feel better all at once.
There are people who are glad you\'re here.
Rest if you need to, but don\'t give up.
Your feelings are real, and so is your ability to get through them.

string-array.name: quotes_default
string-array.item: You are doing your best, and that is enough.
Take it one breath at a time.
Be kind to your mind.
Peace begins with a pause.
You deserve the same kindness you give to others.

string-array.name: affirmations
string-array.item: You don\'t have to have it all figured out to take the next step.
Rest is productive too.
Your feelings are valid, and they will pass.
Progress, not perfection.
You are allowed to take up space.
Breathe in calm. Breathe out what you can\'t control.
Be as kind to yourself as you are to others.
Small steps still move you forward.
You\'ve made it through 100% of your hardest days so far.
It\'s okay to ask for help.
Slow is still moving.
You are more than your productivity.
Let today be enough, just as it is.
Notice one good thing around you right now.
Your pace is the right pace.
Protect your peace.
Drink some water. Stretch. Unclench your jaw.
You are growing, even when you can\'t see it.
Saying no is a form of self-care.
Today, try to be a friend to yourself.
Every day is a chance to begin again.
You don\'t have to fight the current. Float, and let it carry you.
Like the tide, this feeling will come in and go back out.
Beneath every storm, the deep water is still.
Surrender isn\'t giving up. It\'s letting go of what you can\'t hold.
Be still. The waves will settle on their own.
